descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S24 Note prompts match Vikram's original word for word, and Mistral calls carry the same guardrail as Haiku

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T3 The note prompts and templates are unchanged from Vikram's original except approved changes; any other wording change has Vikram's approval on record. (TFA-92592 AC 13; TFA-94229 AC 1; TFA-94229 R1; TFA-94229 R2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr; TFA-94229 in progress
  • T7 Mistral calls go through the same Bedrock guardrail as Haiku. (TFA-94422 AC 4)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Prompt library on main (note/clinical-quality 1.7, note/patient-context, note/snf-patient-context, templates soap, hp, consult, discharge, snf-progress, snf-admission) and prompts.lock.json; prototype RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html; convex/ai/providers/bedrock.ts

When Diff each note prompt against the prototype (whitespace-normalised) and list every difference with its approval; read the Bedrock call path for Haiku and Mistral

Then Every difference is an approved change (TFA-92592 AC 6/7/10/16 fixes, the #100 EARLIER VALUES block); the same guardrailConfig (id and version) is sent for both models

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Doc review. #100's wording has not been reviewed by Vikram yet (TFA-92592 AC 13 note), so any EARLIER VALUES text in the build is an unapproved difference until he signs off

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method STATIC · Static check (build output / scan); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S24 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-14.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: STATIC · Static check (build output / scan); secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

Detail:

Doc review. T7 (TFA-94422 AC 4): passed — convex/ai/providers/ is unchanged between e02167f and 43c38a4f (git diff is empty), so the earlier code review stands: both models go through the same bedrock.invoke with the same guardrailConfig. T3 (TFA-92592 AC 13): prompt parity of 43c38a4f against RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html (scripts/code-review/parity.mjs, whitespace-normalised): templates soap / hp / consult / discharge identical; note/clinical-quality.md 1.7 differs (201/231 sentences verbatim, 29 new); note/patient-context.md 1.5 differs (209/221, 4 changed, 8 new — up from 2 changed / 3 new on e02167f: the #100 'recorded today' / TODAY'S / EARLIER VALUES lines); note/snf-patient-context.md 1.2 (3/16, 13 new — #100); new blocks earlier-vitals-block.md and earlier-labs-block.md (not in the prototype, #100); history-corrections-block.md (1 changed); snf-progress / snf-admission templates differ. docs/2026-10-03-vikram-prompt-batch.md records the #100 wording as Daniela's decision (A3, 10-05: 'no need to ask Vikram, FYI only'), so it is covered by AC 16; the other differences (e.g. the B6 temperature lines of PR #98, decided by Quinn as FYI, and the earlier clinical-quality / SNF template changes) have no Vikram approval on record and the batch to Vikram has not been sent. Blocked on that record: a person maps each listed difference to an approval.

Evidence: 1 attached.

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: scripted-spec, fault-ai (manual: doc-review). This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).

This case has results elsewhere too (a case shows one result: a verdict beats blocked, a run beats a skip; within a tier the worse one, on a tie the earlier one (dev, dev lanes, local lane A/C, new local lanes), test out of date ranks above passed; when all are skips the dev one, unless dev only says "local only / can't run on dev" or gives the lane's own reason):

  • [local code-review] passed (code-review/results.json) — code-review: passed → passed (passed) TFA-94422 part (T7): both models are called through the same bedrock.invoke with the same guardrailConfig, and IAM refuses a call without it (the code read of OAT-03/S23). The prompt half (T3: note prompts word for word against Vikram's original) belongs to TFA-92592 (ready for pr) and TFA-94229 (in progress): todo, and it also needs Vikram's approval record.
